headline: Every tub of ice cream checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: Bulla has been family owned for more than a century, and its new ice cream factory in Colac, next to the Forest Street site, has a cone line with nearly four times the capacity of the one it replaced. New lines are the easiest place to build checks in from day one. This is what a camera check could look like on an ice cream tub line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every tub has its lid on and seated flat. A lifted lid lets frost and air in, and it shows up as a shrunken, icy tub in the freezer at the store.
labelLede: Vanilla and cookies and cream tubs can look much the same at line speed, and one carries wheat the other does not. The camera checks every tub carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every tub. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the flavour and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Glove pieces, lid offcuts and loose machine parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a case.
